test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 14 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The Comprehensive Crop Insurance Scheme (CCIS) was started from 1985 with the objective of providing _______.

options.text: financial support to the farmers for educating their children
financial support to the farmers in the event of crop failure due to drought, flood etc
financial support to the farmers to purchase tractors and other implements
financial support to the farmers to buy HYV seeds

solution:
The correct answer is **__financial support to the farmers in the event of crop failure due to drought, flood, etc__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Comprehensive Crop Insurance Scheme (CCIS)__ **

 
 
• **Started in 1985 with the objective of providing financial support to the farmers in the event of crop failure due to drought, flood, etc.**
 
• Since the inception of the scheme in 1985, about 5.82 crore farmers have been covered up to Rabi 1996- 97 season.
 
• Participation in the scheme was voluntary and the **States were free to opt for the scheme.**
 
• **All farmers who availed of crop loans from:**
 
 
• **Commercial Banks.**
 
• **Regional Rural Bank.**
 
• **Cooperative Banks.**
 
• **For growing wheat, paddy, millets (including maize), oilseeds, and pulses were eligible for coverage under the scheme.**
 
 
 
• CCIS **remained under implementation till Kharif 1999.**
